 Preview: UFC 333 prelims
 Steele vs. Gugnon
 Tom Feely Oct 21, 2026 
 Lightweights
 Kody
Steele (8-1) vs. Noah Gugnon 
(10-2)
 Odds : Steele (-155), Gugnon (+130)
 Advertisement 
With his first UFC victory secured, Kody Steele 
looks to rebuild the momentum he carried into the promotion.
Steele appeared to be one of the more prepared prospects on the
2024 Contender Series. A grappler by background, he had developed a
varied striking attack and applied it with sustained pressure.
His UFC debut was less successful. Steele remained competitive, but
Rongzhu delivered one of his better performances, exploiting the
openings in Steele’s direct, forceful approach. The defeat and a
subsequent injury layoff pushed Steele out of view until May, when
he returned with a heel-hook submission of Dom Mar
Fan .
He now faces Gugnon, who submitted fellow newcomer Milos
Janicic in August. The Frenchman clearly possesses power, but
his overall game remains a work in progress. He has begun
developing options beyond trading punches, although his grappling
often serves primarily to create opportunities for more
offense.
Gugnon could be the stronger hitter if this becomes an attritional
striking battle. Steele’s grappling should give him a more reliable
route to victory.
The pick is Steele by first-round submission.
